responsibility: Declares default-channel decimal text I/O for REAL values. It mirrors RealIO’s explicit-channel operations but binds them to the current standard input and output channels, exposing reading plus floating, engineering, fixed, and adaptive-width writing in the ISO default-stream style.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the interface for default-channel REAL text I/O, declaring the read and formatting procedures exported by the module. It differs from SRealIO.mod, which implements those procedures as calls into RealIO using StdChans channels.
